title: Bite-sized demo frames for field enablement
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a set of compact, slide-ready visual assets (PNG/SVG) derived from live product screenshots to power sales/solutions quickstart decks and field enablement one-pagers. Goal: provide 6-8 modular frames that highlight onboarding flows, key console panels (model selection, rollout controls, cost breakdown, latency charts), and Dedicated/Private deployment callouts. Assets must be annotated, redacted when needed, and exported in desktop and mobile-safe variants. Deliverables: master Figma file, deck-ready slides, high-res PNGs, low-res thumbnails, and a short usage guidance doc for sellers (copy snippets + recommended talking points).
acceptance_criteria:
1) Six distinct frames produced: Onboarding flow, Model catalog + performance badges, Rollout canary config, Cost/latency breakdown sample, Dedicated capacity overview, VPC/private deployment callout.
2) All frames have redacted customer data where applicable and include overlay callouts (arrows + 1-2 sentence caption).
3) Exports: 1920x1080 PNG, 1200x628 social card PNG, and vector SVG for each frame.
4) Figma file contains named components and an export variants page.
5) Quick usage doc (one A4) with 3 slide templates and suggested sales bullet points.
6) Reviewed and approved by PM (Lena Ortiz) and Solutions Lead (Diego Rivera).
